problem.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: Input is sorted in non-decreasing order.
Return the first and last index of target, or [-1,-1] if absent.
The required runtime is O(log n).

claims.claim: lower_bound returns the first index i with nums[i] >= target; upper_bound returns the first index i with nums[i] > target.
claims.validation: Half-open interval partition invariants in article.

claims.claim: If lower_bound is within the array and equals target, the complete target range is [lower_bound, upper_bound - 1].
Two binary searches remain O(log n) time and use O(1) auxiliary space.
claims.validation: Two logarithmic searches with scalar state.
